MarketBite Connections Cafe prototype

Regular menu prices were transcribed from the user-supplied Grubhub screenshots on October 24, 2026. Drinks are excluded. Duplicate Chocolate Croissant/Muffin listings across Pastries and Bakery were consolidated; all distinct foods remain available.

Food photos are representative AI-generated menu imagery, not photographs of Connections Cafe's actual products. Bagel flavors share an everything-bagel category photograph. Logos were supplied by the user. New food assets were made with built-in Imagegen; prompts are in image-prompts.json. The site uses optimized copies in assets/*.webp.

Pricing follows a JavaScript/Decimal implementation of MarketBite Pricing Specification 1.1 / Engine 2.1. Economics and scenario demand are explicit prototype fixtures, not evidence about the cafe. Checkout authorization, acknowledgment, inventory observations, transfers and purchases are simulated. There is no Grubhub/POS connection and no payment collection. Data sync is limited to tabs in this browser.

A stock crash requests guarded batch evaluation. It cannot force a discount or clear a committed window. Study Buddy pairs independently priced foods without an additional shared-stock bundle discount. No carbon or waste-reduction estimates are inferred from sales.
